about: Mercury in each of the twelve bhavas. Mercury takes colour from its co-tenants, so the engine lowers the weight of these rules when a malefic shares the house.

rules.says: Quick, articulate and younger-looking than the years; thinks out loud and is rarely still.
Money is made by talking and dealing; a precise speaker with a head for accounts.
Writing, explaining and negotiating come naturally; curiosity drives frequent short journeys.
Education is taken seriously and the home holds books; property tends to come through paperwork done properly.
A measuring, analytical intelligence suited to teaching and advising; children are bright and talkative.
Wins arguments on detail and can live in the fine print; the nerves and the skin carry whatever is not said.
Partnership is chosen for mind as much as feeling; the partner is often younger, and business suits the chart better than most.
A researching mind that wants the part nobody published; nervous anxiety is the cost of it.
Learning becomes doctrine and then gets taught; publishing, lecturing and travel for study all sit here.
A profession made of words, numbers or trade, usually several roles rather than one title.
Income comes through the network: introductions, intermediation and knowing who to ask.
The mind runs ahead of itself and scatters; well suited to foreign dealings and to work nobody sees being done.
